response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with type other than PRIJEM/VYDAJ (including VYBER and NULL) are excluded entirely, so they affect neither the average signed amount nor the average balance ('left out' is read as excluding those rows from both averages).
Ties in average balance are broken arbitrarily; no rounding is applied.

alternatives.interpretation: Only the signed-amount average ignores other types, but the average balance covers all transactions with amount > 2400, including VYBER and other types.
alternatives.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 2400 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10
